name: Oleamide
aliases: 9-Octadecenamide, ODA, (9Z)-9-Octadecenamide, (Z)-9-Octadecenamide, (Z)-Octadec-9-enoic acid amide, 9Z-octadecenamide, cis-9,10-Octadecenoamide, Oleic acid amide
summary: Oleamide is an organic compound with the formula CH3(CH2)7CH=CH(CH2)7CONH2. It is the amide derived from the fatty acid oleic acid. It is a colorless waxy solid and occurs in nature. Sometimes labeled as a fatty acid primary amide (FAPA), it is biosynthesized from N-oleoylglycine.

uses.en: It is used industrially as a slip agent in plastics and is sold as a supplement. In the laboratory it is studied for effects on sleep.
uses.zh: 它在工業上作為塑膠的滑爽劑使用，也被當作補充品販售。在實驗室中則被研究對睡眠的影響。
uses.zhHans: 它在工业上作为塑料的滑爽剂使用，也被当作补充品贩售。在实验室中则被研究对睡眠的影响。

fact.en: Oleamide was found in the spinal fluid of sleep-deprived cats in 1995 and nicknamed a sleep-inducing lipid. It is also added to plastics, and has leached out of lab plasticware and confused experiments.
fact.zh: 油酰胺在 1995 年於睡眠剝奪貓隻的腦脊髓液中發現，被稱為「誘眠脂質」。它也被添加在塑膠中，曾從實驗室塑膠器材滲出而干擾實驗結果。
fact.zhHans: 油酰胺在 1995 年于睡眠剥夺猫只的脑脊髓液中发现，被称为「诱眠脂质」。它也被添加在塑料中，曾从实验室塑料器材渗出而干扰实验结果。
